All panels are produced by
[`script/FigureS4.R`](https://github.com/dzemmour/immgenT-cosmo-paper/blob/main/script/FigureS4.R).
The code below is shown for reference (not re-executed on this page); the
images are its pre-rendered output.

Panel **S4c** is the distribution of cosine similarity scores for the
expression profiles of cells assigned to the same cluster across datasets. The
similarity matrix it plots is not part of the deposited data, and the panel is
not reproduced here.

## Setup

```{r figs4-setup, code=code_for("../script/FigureS4.R", c("^", "Load data")), eval=FALSE}
```

## (A) Experiment composition of each cluster {#figs4a}

```{r figs4a-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS4.R", "S4a"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs4a-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure4/S4a_cluster_composition_by_IGT.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 4A.** Stacked bar plot showing the experiment (IGT)
composition of each immgenT consensus cluster, demonstrating that no cluster is
experiment-specific, with the exception of the DP clusters that only
thymus-containing experiments contribute to. Each experiment's contribution is
first normalised by its own size, so the plot reports composition rather than
which experiments sequenced the most cells.
:::

## (B) Cluster proportions across spleen standards {#figs4b}

```{r figs4b-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS4.R", "S4b"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs4b-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure4/S4b_cluster_proportions_spleen_standards.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 4B.** Box plots showing the distribution of immgenT
cluster proportions across spleen standard samples, illustrating
reproducibility across experiments. Because the input material is nominally
identical between these samples, the spread is a read-out of measurement
reproducibility rather than of biology. Clusters with fewer than 10 cells in a
sample are excluded.
:::

## (D) Cluster separability in protein space {#figs4d}

```{r figs4d-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS4.R", "S4d"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs4d-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure4/S4d_cluster_separability_ADT.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 4D.** Distribution of cluster separability scores for each
immgenT consensus cluster in protein expression space. Scores > 0 indicate
proteomically distinct clusters; across 3,043 cluster-by-experiment
combinations with at least 10 cells and available CITE-seq data, 95% are
positive. Clusters were defined on RNA, so a positive score here means the
partition is visible in an independent measurement modality. Colours indicate
experiment (IGT).
:::
